title: TRACE-CASH: Trial-History-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Configuration Exploration in Time-Series CASH
abstract: arXiv:2608.16410v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Combined algorithm selection and hyperparameter optimization (CASH) searches a conditional space in which the selected model determines which hyperparameters are active. In time-series forecasting, temporal choices, chronological validation, and costly evaluations further complicate this search. Controlled comparisons of heterogeneous search methods under a shared time-series CASH (TS-CASH) evaluation protocol remain limited. Within this setting, we study TRACECASH, a task-local hybrid sequential optimizer combining grouped actor-critic candidate generation with fixed rules for model coverage, validation-guided exploitation, and exploration after stalled progress. A model actor proposes an initial forecasting model; three model-conditioned actors generate temporal, architectural, and training actions; and a modelspecific decoder constructs the configuration ultimately evaluated. We compare TRACE-CASH with six alternatives spanning random

translated_title: TRACE-CASH：基于试验历史条件强化学习的时间序列CASH自适应配置探索
translated_abstract: 组合算法选择与超参数优化（CASH）在条件空间中搜索，其中所选模型决定了哪些超参数处于激活状态。在时间序列预测中，时间选择、时序验证和昂贵评估进一步增加了搜索复杂性。在共享时间序列CASH（TS-CASH）评估协议下，异构搜索方法的受控比较仍然有限。在此设置中，我们研究了TRACECASH，一种任务本地混合顺序优化器，将分组演员-评论家候选生成与固定规则相结合，用于模型覆盖、验证引导利用及停滞进展后的探索。模型演员提出初始预测模型；三个模型条件演员生成时间、架构和训练动作；模型特定解码器构建最终评估的配置。我们将TRACE-CASH与六种备选方案进行比较，涵盖随机搜索等。
tldr: 本文提出TRACE-CASH，一种结合分组强化学习与固定规则的时间序列CASH优化器，通过条件化候选生成和验证引导探索，有效应对时间序列预测中的复杂配置搜索挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TRACE-CASH, a time-series CASH optimizer combining grouped reinforcement learning with fixed rules, using conditioned candidate generation and validation-guided exploration to address complex configuration search challenges in time-series forecasting.
